area: Webhooks: create endpoint and overview
facts: GET handshake returns 200 with hub.challenge; POST carries X-Hub-Signature-256.
Non-200 deliveries retried with decreasing frequency for up to 7 days; payloads up to 3 MB; one endpoint per Meta app; mTLS supported.
